quests.title: Cooking, the Aroma of Homecoming

dialogue.t: (A huge leaf. Someone has written on it with messy handwriting...)
"...The 17th time frost covered the leaves. After some tests, I noticed that water from tributaries is filled with sand and mud. It has an earthen taste. Not acceptable."
"...The 30th time frost covered the leaves. It's raining again. Not acceptable."
"...The 60th time frost covered the leaves. After some tests, I noticed that water from a river's main stem makes much more aromatic soup, but it still isn't enough. Not acceptable."
"...The 80th time frost covered the leaves. It rained as soon as I finished my soup. Luckily, I wore a hat. Hmm, the quality of this water isn't bad."
Whoa, what's cooking in there? Paimon's mouth is watering from just a whiff of it!
It looks like some kind of soup. Hmm... Paimon can't tell what's inside...
Hey, {NICKNAME}...
The person cooking it isn't here, and it smells so good. Let's have a mouthful while it's left unattended.
Yay!

dialogue.sit:
The pot is smaller than it looks.
The soup within it is all gone just like that.

dialogue.t: Ahh... Huh? It smells good, but why doesn't Paimon taste anything?
Great Aramuhukunda! What are you Nara doing!?
A—Aranara? Where did you come from?
From underground! Forget that, why are you drinking my soup? Arapas worked very hard on that!
Sorry...
Hmph! You stole my soup! Sorry won't cut it!
Do you know how difficult it is to make soup here? One minute it's rainy; one minute it's sunny.
I finally managed to make this pot of soup, but while I was away picking Fresh Harra Fruits, you...
It smelled too good to resist...
But if it's that difficult, why are you cooking here?
Hmph! The key to cooking must be collected every day, which is...

dialogue.sit: The will to never forget your dreams?

dialogue.t: Water! It's water! Water has a huge impact on the aroma of my soup. So it has to be made with the best water!
I've been collecting water throughout Apam Woods to make soup with. After collecting water samples as numerous as the leaves on a tree, I finally found the best "Living Spring."
It's the only water source fit for Festival Utsava's supreme delicacy! You wouldn't get it even if I told you... Only that Nara from before...
Speaking of which, Arapacati sent us...

dialogue.sit: You bring Arapas up to speed on the events so far...

dialogue.t: Ah, you're Nara friends of my sister! And Festival Utsava is coming!
It's fine. I've found Living Spring, and my Supreme Delicacy is complete. It's in this pot... Oh, right...
Eh-hehe... Don't be sad, at least your soup was really aromatic...
Ah! My Living Spring! "Apshvaana" live at its source. I waited so long for them to leave and only collected a pot of it...
No! You must get me another pot of Living Spring!
"Apshvaana"? What's that?
Hmph! You Nara really know nothing about the forest. They live in the water, and they have four legs, a tail, and they bite.
...Dogs?

dialogue.sit: Dogs don't live in the water.

dialogue.t: Ah, right. Then what's an "Apshvaana"?
Forget that! I want my water! And I want Living Spring from there in particular!
Alright, alright... {NICKNAME}, we don't have a choice here. Let's go...
It must be Living Spring and no other!

Do you know how difficult it is to make soup here? One minute it's rainy; one minute it's sunny.
Hmm... Speaking of which, Varuna Contraption has been much more stable lately, and the weather has become normal again...
Actually, it was us...
Hmph! I'm sure it was a good Nara like that Nara who repaired Varuna Contraption! It wasn't soup thieves like the two of you...
Hey, don't be so mean! It just smelled too good to resist...
But if it's that difficult, why are you cooking here?

Forget that! I want my water! And I want Living Spring from there in particular!
Alright, alright... {NICKNAME}, we don't have a choice here. Let's go...
It must be Living Spring and no other!
My soup... *sob* How could this happen...
Hmph! Both of you are bad Nara! Don't even think about tricking me with water from somewhere else!
Hmm... It is the water from the river's source. The Living Spring that's cold and clean, just like moonlight.
Arachatora, Arasaka, and Araphala wouldn't be so stupid if they grew up drinking this water. Only Arapacati, my sister...
Well, what's next...
Huh? Oh. Next up, you have to make me a new pot of soup...

dialogue.sit:
Receiving guidance from Arapas, you add some fruits and vegetables into the water and start cooking.
A rather nice aroma slowly emerges from the pot.

Once you're done, you taste the fresh soup together.
It sort of lives up to your expectations. It does carry the aroma of the ingredients...
But a soup without any condiments is just too plain.
It has no flavor at all.

dialogue.t: Mmm, this is how the supreme delicacy should smell!
Hmm... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: It can quench thirst as soups should.
It's too healthy for me, I think...

dialogue.t: Paimon thinks it would be better with some salt and pepper.

dialogue.sit: Everything is better with salt and pepper.

dialogue.t: Great Aramuhukunda! You want to add salt? What a horrifying idea!
Land with salt is land without life, and Aranara will be forced to shrink into seeds. Yet Nara wish to add salt!?
Soups are supposed to be bland! How do you Nara not even understand that!?
That Nara from before told us a story after having a bowl of my soup:
"When we Nara children come home, the aroma of soup is the first thing we smell. As such, aroma is all a soup needs."
After that, he(she) complimented the aroma of the soup I made. I've never forgotten that. That's why I won't believe a word you say!
But just aroma isn't enough...
Hmph! But since you're the Nara of this Festival Utsava, I'm sure you've received approval from Araja and Arapacati. So... I'll try making a soup with taste.
Next time, I'll look for even better water, so we can make even better soup!

dialogue.sit: ...I don't think water is the problem.

dialogue.t: Really? Anyway, my cooking training has concluded. Alright, let's see what we can do about this at Festival Utsava!
I've taught you how to make the soup. It's a soup approved by the Great Nara, so do give it a few more tries. But make sure you don't forget to use good water!
({NICKNAME}, let's add some seasoning next time. It should be pretty good after that...)
Is there water that can give taste to soup?

quests.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arapas is doing “cooking training” close to Apam Woods. Look for a pillar of smoke near Apam Woods!
